title: 第009章 差别待遇师兄吃丹药师弟吃大逼兜第010章 再次饲养返还天赋
slug: 九叔饲养百倍返还僵尸成旱魃
content_zh:
苏辰沉浸在领悟中，
此刻他的脑海中，真武大帝的虚影散发着无尽的威严，不断的影响着他。
各式的斩邪剑招在他心间流淌而过，那些平平无奇的招式此刻竟多了几分神韵！
那些剑招一遍遍的在脑海中演示，深深的烙印在他的潜意识中。
斩邪剑法的精髓被其一点点的消化，足足过了半个时辰，苏辰才清醒过来。
而在清醒的那一刻，苏辰明显的感觉到了自己对于斩邪剑法，似乎有了更为深刻的领悟。
仿佛在一瞬间，他知道该怎么用剑了！
九叔看到苏辰清醒，眼神中的期待愈发的浓郁，“领悟的怎么样？”
“脱胎换骨！”
苏辰语气平静，却透着一股前所未有的自信，“弟子以前只知死记硬背剑招，就像那三岁幼童挥舞大锤，只知用力，不知用劲，徒有其表罢了。”
“但今日得见师父展现真武神意，弟子方才摸到了几分门槛！”
“原来这剑法，不在于招式的花哨，而在于‘剑出斩邪，意在荡魔’的决绝！”
听着苏辰这番不骄不躁、却直指大道本源的感悟，九叔背在身后的双手猛地攥紧，连呼吸都重了几分。
摸到门槛？！
你管这叫摸到门槛？！
这特么是把门槛直接踩碎，几乎要一脚踹进了圆满境界的大门里了吧！
九叔心里简直想仰天长笑三声。
苏辰这表现，何止是出乎意料，简直是老天爷瞎了眼......呸，是祖师爷显灵开眼了啊！
有此番感悟，说明苏辰的斩邪剑法不仅已经大成，甚至正大步流星地向着圆满层次迈进！
之前，九叔还在为两个月后的茅山授箓大典发愁。

去吧？
自己这个大徒弟虽然稳重，但在那些天赋异禀的各脉天才面前，修为确实拿不出手，万一被人几招打下擂台，他林九这辈子的老脸往哪搁？
不去吧？
背后少不了被龙虎山和茅山那帮老对头戳脊梁骨，笑话他林九后继无人。
但现在？！
九叔心里那块大石头瞬间落了地！
有这等夹杂着真武神意的剑法在手，就算苏辰修为稍微低一线，同境界内谁敢说稳赢他？！
绝对拿得出手！！
绝对大长脸！！
只要接下来的两个月，自己多贴补点资源，说不定还能把苏辰的境界硬生生推到道士后期！
到时候，看谁还敢嚼舌根！
想到这里，九叔嘴角都快咧到耳根了，伸手就在乾坤袋里摸索起来，准备把这次外出接活赚来的好东西掏出来给大徒弟补补身子。
可就在他正掏着的时候，前院厢房的方向突然传来“吱呀”一声刺耳的开门声。
“哈——困死了......”
“呜......师兄，今天吃什么啊......”
秋生和文才顶着一头如同鸡窝般的乱发，打着哈欠，趿拉着布鞋从屋里晃晃悠悠地走了出来。
两人衣衫发皱，扣子都扣错了一排，眼角还挂着没擦干净的眼屎。
文才甚至还把手伸进裤子里，旁若无人地挠了挠屁股。
可当他们半眯着眼睛抬起头时，整个人瞬间像被施了定身咒一样，僵在了原地。
院子中央。

九叔正背着双手，面沉如水地盯着他们。
前一秒看苏辰时那如沐春风的慈祥笑容，此刻已经彻底结成了万载玄冰。
两人脸上的困意，当场被吓散到了九霄云外。
“师......师父？您什么时候回来的？”秋生咽了口唾沫，声音都拐了三个弯。
content_en:
Su Chen was immersed in understanding,
At this moment, in his mind, the shadow of Emperor Zhenwu exuded endless majesty, constantly affecting him.
Various evil-killing sword moves flowed through his heart, and those ordinary moves actually had a bit more charm at this moment!
Those sword moves were demonstrated over and over again in his mind, deeply imprinted on his subconscious.
The essence of the evil-killing sword technique was digested bit by bit, and it took half an hour for Su Chen to wake up.
At the moment when he woke up, Su Chen clearly felt that he seemed to have a deeper understanding of the evil-killing sword technique.
As if in an instant, he knew how to use the sword!
Uncle Jiu saw that Su Chen was awake, and the anticipation in his eyes became more intense, "How do you understand?"
"Reborn!"
Su Chen's tone was calm, but revealed an unprecedented sense of confidence, "Disciples used to only memorize sword moves, just like the three-year-old child wielding a sledgehammer. He only knew how to use force but not how hard it was. It was just a show."
"But today I saw the master show his true martial will, and the disciple has just touched the threshold!"
"It turns out that this swordsmanship does not lie in the fancy moves, but in the determination of 'the sword is out to kill evil, and the intention is to destroy the devil'!"
Listening to Su Chen's sentiments, which were neither arrogant nor arrogant, but pointed directly to the origin of the avenue, Uncle Jiu's hands behind his back clenched tightly, and he even breathed a little heavier.
Touching the threshold? !
Do you call this reaching the threshold? !
This is like trampling the threshold to pieces, almost kicking him into the door of the realm of perfection!
Uncle Jiu just wanted to look up to the sky and laugh three times.
Su Chen's performance was not only unexpected, it was like God was blinded... Bah, it was the Patriarch who showed up and opened his eyes!
This realization shows that Su Chen's evil-killing sword technique has not only become a master, but is even striding towards the level of perfection!
Before, Uncle Jiu was still worried about the Maoshan enshrinement ceremony in two months.
Go ahead?
Although he is a stable disciple, his cultivation is really incompetent in front of those talented geniuses from all walks of life. If someone knocks him off the stage with a few moves, where will he, Lin Jiu, put his old face in this life?
Not going?
Behind the scenes, the old enemies of Longhushan and Maoshan inevitably poked him in the back, making fun of Lin Jiu who had no successor.
But now? !
The big stone in Uncle Jiu's heart suddenly fell to the ground!
With such swordsmanship mixed with true martial arts and divine will in hand, even if Su Chen's cultivation level is slightly lower, who in the same realm can say that he can definitely beat him? !
Definitely got it! !
Absolutely long face! !
As long as I provide more resources in the next two months, I might be able to push Su Chen's level to the late Taoist stage!
When the time comes, let’s see who dares to gossip!
Thinking of this, Uncle Jiu grinned from the corner of his mouth to his ears. He reached out and fumbled in the Qiankun bag, preparing to take out the good things he earned from this outing to help his eldest disciple.
But just as he was taking it out, there was a harsh "squeak" sound of the door opening suddenly coming from the direction of the wing in the front yard.
"Ha-I'm so sleepy..."
"Ugh...senior brother, what are you going to eat today..."
Qiu Sheng and Wen Cai, with their hair as messy as a chicken coop, yawned and staggered out of the house, pulling on their cloth shoes.
Their clothes were wrinkled, the buttons were buttoned in the wrong row, and there was unwiped eye mucus hanging from the corners of their eyes.
Wencai even put his hand into his pants and scratched his butt as if no one else was watching.
But when they raised their heads with half-squinted eyes, their whole bodies instantly froze in place as if a restraining spell had been cast on them.
In the center of the courtyard.
Uncle Jiu was staring at them with his hands behind his back and his face as grave as water.
The kind smile that looked like a spring breeze when he looked at Su Chen a second ago has completely turned into ten thousand years of ice.
The sleepiness on their faces was frightened away on the spot.
"Master...Master? When did you come back?" Qiu Sheng swallowed and saidYindu turned three corners.
